title: Tech Note: Using 4D version 6.5 Browse and Download Files via FTP

historical_commentary.text: FTP was a primary file transfer mechanism in 1999, and 4D Internet Commands provided FTP client capabilities. FTP usage has declined dramatically in favor of HTTPS-based APIs and cloud storage. 4D Internet Commands' FTP functions are obsolete; modern 4D uses HTTP/HTTPS via built-in commands or cURL integration for file transfers.
related_updates: FTP has been largely replaced by HTTPS, SFTP, and cloud storage APIs
4D Internet Commands plugin has been superseded by built-in HTTP commands and 4D.HTTPRequest
